name: Mitsubishi Gas Chemical Company, Inc.
summary: Mitsubishi Gas Chemical Company, Inc. manufactures and sells basic and fine chemicals, and functional materials in Japan. It operates through Green Energy & Chemicals Business, Functional Chemicals, and Other segments. The company offers organic synthetic products, paint resin, hydrogen peroxide, ultra-pure hydrogen, polycarbonate resin, printed wiring, methanol, and polycarbonate sheets and films; and manufacture and sell fragrance products, general aromatic chemicals, special aromatic chemicals, foam plastics, and electricity.
